Zero dependencies.","id":"gh:1337932836","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-worlds","slug":"frozo-ai/dsh-worlds","topics":["deepseek-harness","docker","dsh","dsh-plugin","execution-world","sandbox"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Remote execution worlds for DeepSeek Harness: run the agent's Bash, terminals, LSP and file tools in"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"side a container. Zero dependencies."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-worlds"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Run the agent's execution world inside a container — so it survives the harness that started it.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness records this limitation in `packages/terminal/terminal/README.md`:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> "Sessions are process-local and are **not restored after a harness restart**.""},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The session log is durable. The *computer* the agent was working on is not — the shell dies with the"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" harness, taking your cwd, exported variables, and background processes with it."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"`dsh-worlds` fixes that by moving the execution world into a Docker container. No CRIU, no microVMs:"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" a container simply outlives its client."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Why two plugins move everything"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"From the harness's own architecture docs:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> "The existing `dsh-bash-local`, `dsh-terminal-bash`, and `dsh-lsp-stdio` **need no forks**. They d"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"elegate every execution-world operation to `ctx.fs` and `ctx.subprocess`.""},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Implement those two seams and Bash, persistent PTY terminals, LSP, and every file tool relocate into"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" the container automatically. That is a deliberate architectural gift, and this project is what happ"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ens when you take it."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Status"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Capability | Checks |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Docker Engine API client + stream demux | 11 unit + 12 live |
| `ctx.fs` — all 12 methods | 38 liv"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"e |
| Bounded collect buffers (offset-based, non-consuming) | 11 unit |
| `ctx.subprocess` — spawn, "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"tree termination, `waitForExit` | 22 live |
| PTY — `spawnTerminal`, resize, foreground signalling |"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" 17 live |
| **Total** | **111** |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Zero npm dependencies. `node:http`, `node:net`, `node:crypto` only."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Try it"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Requires Docker and a dsh checkout that has been built."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Then install it into a dsh profile — it ships a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so it
mounts by package name "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"with no path editing:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Add `dsh-worlds` to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, then run normally —
no `--patch` flag neede"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"d `dsh-worlds` to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, then run normally —
no `--patch` flag needed:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## The demo"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Honest limits"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **The container is the boundary, not the sandbox seam.** The overlay disables `sandbox`, `bash-san"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"dbox` and `permission-presets`, and forces `danger-full-access`. Per-call sandbox modes (`read-only`"},{"id":"p27s3","text":" / `workspace-write`) are no longer enforced at the bash layer. Host confinement is meaningless for "},{"id":"p27s4","text":"a process that isn't on this kernel — but the container fences the *host*, not the workspace, which "},{"id":"p27s5","text":"is coarser.
- **`stdin: 'pipe'`** (ongoing protocol writes) is not implemented; it rejects loudly ra"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"ther than hanging. Batch `stdin: { data }` works.
- **`inputWaiting` is a heuristic** — a blocked tt"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"y read and an idle sleep are indistinguishable from `/proc` alone.
- **The image must provide `bash`"},{"id":"p27s8","text":", `ps`, and `base64`.** `DockerWorld` installs `bash`/`procps` via apk or apt when missing, and fail"},{"id":"p27s9","text":"s loudly if it can't.
- **Path mirroring:** dsh passes the *host* workspace path as cwd and the prov"},{"id":"p27s10","text":"ider creates it inside the container. Real workspace access needs a bind mount (`binds` in `WorldCon"},{"id":"p27s11","text":"fig`).
- dsh itself is a developer preview with breaking changes; pin versions."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"`SCOPE.md` carries the full interface map, size benchmarks, and every bug found along the way."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"MIT. Not affiliated with DeepSeek AI."}],"truncated":false}
